title: Enhanced elimination of Cr(VI) by sulphidated nanoscale zero valent iron biochar composites: performance and mechanism
content:

DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05234C, Paper

Meijuan Kuang, Qi Qin, Yun Li, Jiayi Lian, Changjiang Yu, Hui Yu, Tiantian Peng, Zhenya Jia, Xiaomao Song, Liantong Wang
Nanoscale zero-valent iron–biochar (BC@Fe) composites were synthesised via a one-step carbothermal method, followed by sulphidation to obtain sulphided BC@Fe (S-nZVI/BC-C-X) composites.
